title: an async Optional-returning function lifts through Promise<Optional<T>>, and await removes only the Promise layer
notes: specification/type-system.mdx, 'Async Values': 'Awaiting the call removes only the Promise layer.' Combined with the 'Optional' section's lifting rule, `return "Ada"` inside Promise<Optional<string>> must reach the caller as a present Optional and `return undefined` as an absent one.
